meta.title: Economic expectations
meta.question: Do Poles expect the economy to improve?
meta.measure: Average expectation for the Polish economy in the coming year, from 0 (much worse) to 10 (much better)
meta.anchor: Pooled from every question on the Polish economy in the coming year, with every answer placed on 0 to 10 and the trend read on the scale of an average question.

items.wording: Will the economic situation improve or get worse over the next two years? (1990-91)
items.notes: CBOS 1990-01 to 1991-11, 21 surveys: two-year horizon, so an item of its own.

items.wording: Over the next 12 months, will the economic situation in our country get a lot better ... a lot worse?
Will the country's economic situation improve, stay the same or get worse next year?
In the coming year will the economic situation in Poland improve (10), stay the same (5) or get worse (0)?
items.notes: CBOS, 1992-01 to 2017-12, 306 surveys (monthly from 1993). 1998-10/11 labels lack diacritics ('sie'). From 24 October 2026 coded in the collapsed form CBOS's reports print (no 'definitely'/'rather' split), in the microdata as in the reports of 2018-2026, so that the item is one series to 2026.

items.wording: Expected change in Poland's economic situation over the next 12 months
Will the next twelve months be better, worse or the same for the economic situation in (our country)?
items.notes: Candidate Countries Eurobarometer, 2001-2004, 5 surveys. Codes: 1 same (5), 2 worse (0), 3 better (10).

items.wording: Economic situation in Poland in a year (PGSW 2000)
Over the next 12 months, do you expect the economic situation in our country to improve a lot ... worsen a lot?
items.notes: Pew, Polish readings 2002, 2008, 2009 (spring), 2010-2015 (9); the regex also matches 2016-17, when Poland was not asked.

items.wording: Over the next 12 months, will the general economic situation in Poland get a lot better ... a lot worse?
items.notes: European Election Studies 2004, 2009, 2014, 2019 (2004 value labels read like the retrospective item but the variable is the prospective one).

items.wording: Will the next twelve months be better, worse or the same for the economic situation in (our country)?
items.notes: Eurobarometer, 2004-2026, 49 surveys. 'Same' = 5. In ZA4744 the TCC version carries the same label (second match, no Polish answers; the first match is the right one).

items.wording: In the coming year will the economic situation in Poland improve (10), stay the same (5) or get worse (0)?
items.notes: CBOS's mixed-mode surveys (CAPI, CATI or CAWI, the respondent's choice) from APiW 359 (May-June 2020), so a question of its own.

items.wording: In one year's time, will the economy of (our country) be better, worse or the same? (EP surveys)
items.notes: Eurobarometer/EP surveys 2020-2024, 8 surveys ('NATIONAL ECONOMY IN ONE YEARS TIME'), sometimes in the same survey as EB_ECON_EXP.
